stops.name: Bregenz
stops.detail: Among Austria's most heavily forested regions are the Waldviertel in Lower Austria, the Bregenzerwald in Vorarlberg, the Lungau in SalzburgerLand, the Nockberge Biosphere Reserve in Carinthia and the Silberregion Karwendel in Tirol. From dense mountain forests and expansive stone pine woods to extensive stands of maple, each region offers its own forest experience.
